notes.title: The Mammoth now in 25 languages!
notes.content:
Woah! That's a lot of languages! Thanks to all of our wonderful community translators for submitting their work!

Many of the new languages aren't supported by Steam, but you can choose your language in-game, from this huge list:

[list]
[*]Arabic
[*]Basque
[*]Belarusian
[*]Bulgarian
[*]Catalan
[*]Chinese
[*]Czech
[*]Danish
[*]Dutch
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Hebrew
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Mongolian
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Serbian
[*]Spanish
[*]Thai
[*]Turkish
[*]Ukrainian
[/list]

notes.title: The Mammoth now available in even more languages!
notes.content:
Thanks to you, our amazing players, The Mammoth: A Cave Painting is now also available in Spanish, Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese and Serbian!

If you would like to help us to translate our short free game into your language as well check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/751690/discussions/0/1488866180591964915/]this forum post for details![/url]

Thank you so much for your support and your touching reviews - it really means the world to us.

Love,
inbetweengames

notes.title: The Mammoth: A Cave Painting, now on Steam!
notes.content:
Today we're launching the debut game from inbetweengames, The Mammoth, on Steam, for free!

Thie 5-minute story was created by the inbetweengames team, with our good friends Daniel Nordlander and Bairbre Bent, back in 2015 for the Ludum Dare game jam. You can read more about how we created the game, and started inbetweengames, in [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/VCNH3]this post[/url].

For the Steam release, we've added controller support, as well as translations for French, German and Polish. If you'd like to help translate the game into your language, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/751690/discussions/0/1488866180591964915/]this forum post[/url] for details!
